name: oortmem
description: Oort: open-source memory for AI agents. oort gives Claude Code memory across sessions; oort-dev helps you build Oort into your own apps.

plugins.name: oort
plugins.description: Memory for Claude Code: recall before each prompt, save after each turn, plus the Oort memory tools.

plugins.name: oort-dev
plugins.description: Build with Oort: a skill that teaches Claude to integrate the oortmem TypeScript SDK and the oort CLI into your own apps, services and agent frameworks (Vercel AI SDK, LangGraph.js, OpenAI Agents JS, Python via the CLI). No hooks, no MCP server.
